# Third-party files bundled for offline use

| File | Project | Version | License |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| `chart.umd.js` | [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org/) | 4.4.1 | MIT (`LICENSE-chartjs.md`) |
| `fonts/fraunces-latin-opsz-*.woff2` | [Fraunces](https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces) via `@fontsource-variable/fraunces` | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `fonts/hanken-grotesk-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | [Hanken Grotesk](https://github.com/marcologous/hanken-grotesk) via `@fontsource-variable/hanken-grotesk` | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Nothing is loaded from a CDN: SubSweep runs fully offline apart from the optional PayPal and Anthropic calls.
